scope: Separate electronics-bay access study with discrete heatset bosses and a balanced C14 corner position; production enclosure is unchanged.

c14.balance_basis: Approximately equal scanned-flange clearance to the ideal left inner wall and ordinary ceiling underside

retention_detail: Four discrete integral corner bosses are the panel's only bearing surfaces. Each boss has a 9 mm root into its adjacent front/rear fixed roof edge; the rear roots fill the rear-wall thickness. The −X pair connect into the sidewall. The +X pair also have full-depth 9 mm roots into the +X fixed roof, supporting each boss on two sides. Four recessed M3x12 screws engage RX-M3x5.7 heatsets. No perimeter rim.
assembly_purpose: Connect the rear-wall C14 inlet to the cold-core-mounted Mean Well through the open electronics bay, then install the empty panel last.
